svg.desc: CEZ Job Finder icon, route "disc", hand-tuned 32 px rung: whole pixels, flat ink tile 26 at 3 (Mac margin). Paper disc 19 px (r 9.5 at 15.5,15.5: 3 px of tile left and above, 4 right and below). Bird = small.svg's skeleton refitted: head r 3.5 at 19.5,11.5, breast r 4.5 at 17.5,17.5, 45 degree band 3 px tall cut square at x 9, r 1 at the nape and under the tail, throat r 3.5; legs 1 px wide, 1 apart, running to the disc's lower edge; eye 1 px; beak 2 px deep, 2 px seated in the head, full depth across the paper to x 25 so its point lies on the dark tile. Ink box 18 px, tail to beak. Beak one colour, orange #e57a00: too short here for the two-tone bill (a 1 px yellow row is lost on the white disc).
